item.title: Senior Software Engineer - Java at Hatchyard
item.content:encoded:
Company: Hatchyard
Location: Colombo
Job Type: Full-time

Description:

Senior Software Engineer - Java

Key Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering.
  • 3+ years of solid experience in software design and development using Java.
  • Strong understanding and hands-on experience in multithreading, performance optimization, memory management, Java Generics.
  • Experience in unit testing, performance profiling, and debugging (execution and memory).
  • Solid experience with the standard Java libraries.
  • Experience in Python or other scripting languages.
  • Experience in cloud technologies such as K8S, Docker, GCP, AWS, PaaS.
  • Experience in coding assistants such as Cursor/Copilot/Antigravity. Experience or knowledge of AI/ML concepts is a major plus.
  • Experience with build systems such as Maven, and CI/CD.
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as Java performance profilers, debuggers, JVM analyzers, Git, and various IDEs/editors.
  • Experience in distributed systems is a plus.
  • Experience working in Unix-based systems is a plus.
  • Experience in designing and developing high-performance asynchronous systems is a plus.

item.title: Intern - Odoo Developer at EverestX Technologies
item.content:encoded:
Company: EverestX Technologies
Location: Colombo
Job Type: Internship

Description:

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Odoo Developer Intern to join our team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone interested in ERP systems, Python development, and business application customization to gain hands-on experience working on real-world Odoo projects.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in developing and customizing Odoo modules.
  • Support the development of new features and enhancements for existing Odoo applications.
  • Work with Python, XML, PostgreSQL, and JavaScript.
  • Assist with Odoo integrations using REST APIs and third-party services.
  • Troubleshoot bugs, test features, and improve application performance.
  • Collaborate with senior developers and other team members.
  • Maintain technical documentation and follow development best practices.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in IT, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Basic knowledge of Python programming.
  • Familiarity with databases and SQL.
  • Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and XML is an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of Git and version control.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn.
  • Good communication and teamwork skills.

What We Offer

  • Hands-on experience with real-world Odoo ERP projects.
  • Mentorship and guidance from experienced developers.
  • Exposure to ERP customization, API integrations, and business workflows.
  • Opportunities to develop technical and professional skills.
  • Potential for a full-time opportunity based on performance.

Job Type: Internship

Experience Level: Entry Level / Freshers Welcome

How to Apply: Send your CV to our recruitment email address to apply for this opportunity.



Apply for this job
